prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 casual summer lifestyle portrait of an adult East Asian woman with a feminine silhouette, resting comfortably on green grass beneath a large weathered tree. Use a grass-level low angle with leafy branches and blue sky overhead. Keep the lavender camisole, colorful swirled skirt, white sneakers, and subtle layered gold necklaces shown; her long brunette hair catches warm backlight. She smiles softly at the camera in a relaxed, playful manner. Use filtered 4800K golden-hour sunlight, dappled leaf shadows, and light gently highlighting her shoulders and chest area through the camisole, with warm medium-format film color, natural skin texture, and shallow depth of field. Keep the full composition fashion-lifestyle focused, with no sexualized pose, text, logo, or watermark.
